title: FamilyMart Socks Save Uzbekistan at Asian Games
paragraphs: At the Asian Games in Japan, Uzbekistan's volleyball players attracted attention for an unusual part of their uniforms — their socks.

During a match against Japan on September 27, fans noticed that the players were all wearing the same white socks with green and blue stripes. They were FamilyMart socks, sold by one of Japan's major convenience store chains. The socks are a popular item in Japan, with more than 30 million pairs sold since they were released in 2021.
But these socks weren't a fashion statement — they were a last-minute solution to a problem the Uzbek team hadn't expected to face.
Volleyball rules require players on a team to wear identical jerseys, shorts and socks — with exceptions for the libero, a special defensive player.
But the Uzbek team, which doesn't have much experience competing at major international tournaments, hadn't known about the rule, and brought socks in different colors and lengths.
With little time before their first match, the team needed to quickly find enough identical pairs for everyone.

Fortunately, a FamilyMart next to their hotel had enough matching socks for the whole team. They chose the convenience store's famous Line Socks with stripes in green and blue, FamilyMart's brand colors.
The colors were a fitting choice, as one player pointed out that the green and blue stripes match Uzbekistan's flag.
This is only Uzbekistan's second tournament at such a high level, and the players say they plan to make sure all their uniforms match before future competitions.
FamilyMart, meanwhile, was pleased to see its socks being worn at the Asian Games, which began on September 19, and will end on October 4.
"We are extremely pleased and proud that our Line Socks were worn at such a prestigious international sporting event," the company told The Mainichi.
For the Uzbek team, having a convenience store next to their hotel proved even more convenient than they could have expected!
